Do you need help?

Start with a call. The team can explain who can stay, whether there is space and what to do before you arrive.

Let’s talk about a place.

You can call for yourself or someone else. Tell the team that you need accommodation and ask whether HUP can help with your situation.

Call 068 023 3487Or call 074 665 7384

If you cannot get through, email hupnpo@gmail.com.

A website enquiry does not reserve a bed. Please speak to HUP before travelling.

AT A GLANCE

Temporary shelter and support

HUP is based in Pretoria and is listed as a men’s shelter. Alongside accommodation, its work includes counselling, help with finding work and specialist referrals.

Explore the support available ↗

PLAN YOUR VISIT

Before you arrive.

Keep these questions handy when you call. The team will explain what applies to you.

01

Who can stay?

Explain who needs a place and ask about admission. If HUP cannot accommodate you, ask whether the team can suggest another service.

02

Is there space?

Ask about accommodation for the day you intend to arrive. Availability can change; please confirm directly with HUP.

03

What should I bring?

Ask about identification, other documents and personal items. Tell the team if you do not have your documents with you.

04

What are the arrangements?

Check any fees, the length of stay and the house rules. Ask the team to explain anything you are unsure about.

05

Where and when?

HUP is at 577 De Kock Street, Sunnyside, Pretoria. Agree on an arrival time and ask whom you should speak to when you get there.

06

What support do I need?

Ask about counselling, work support or a specialist referral. You can talk through personal details with the team directly.

DAILY LIFE AT HUP

Meal times for our clients

HUP’s daily meal timetable applies to clients at the shelter. Please be present during the serving times below.

Breakfast
06:00–07:00
Lunch
12:00–13:00
Supper
19:00–20:00

Please arrive on time

  • Meals are served during the scheduled times.
  • Clients must be present during serving time.
  • One meal per client, per serving.
  • Late arrivals may miss the meal.
  • Meal times are supervised.

If work or job-seeking affects your meal times, discuss special arrangements with a supervisor or social worker.

These are meal times for HUP clients. Contact the team about admission, visiting hours or other meal enquiries.

Questions about staying at HUP

Can I arrive without calling? +

Please call first to confirm space, the correct address and when the team can receive you.

Can women, children or families stay? +

HUP is listed as a men’s shelter. Call about your situation and ask whether HUP can accommodate you or suggest another service.

What if I don’t have an identity document? +

Tell the team when you call. Ask what documents are required and what to do if you do not have them.

Is accommodation free? +

Ask HUP about any fees and what they cover before you travel. Current charges are not published here.

How long can I stay? +

Discuss this with the team. The length of stay and the support you receive depend on the shelter’s current arrangements and your situation.

Are meals provided? +

HUP has a daily meal timetable for clients: breakfast 06:00–07:00, lunch 12:00–13:00 and supper 19:00–20:00. Discuss special arrangements with a supervisor or social worker if you will be working or looking for work during these times.

Can I book a bed online? +

No. Only the shelter team can confirm accommodation. Call 068 023 3487 or 074 665 7384.
